[Trend Position]
· Current price ($64,125) vs SMA5/20/50 ($68,412/$92,277/$100,529): Below short/mid-term trends, indicating a weak phase.
· Significantly below SMA100/200 ($130,423/$112,237): Confirms weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (12.4%) + Current price level near historical lows.

· RSI trajectory (27.3→28.5): Attempting to exit oversold territory, weak recovery momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-4591.1865→-3035.4110): Bearish convergence phase, improvement signal confirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $52,689): Approaching lower band, band width expanded to 85.80%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($41,000): Support expected based on Pivot S1 ($43,487).
· Swing resistance ($80,380): First resistance zone for short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Potential Higher Low formation, 5-day low $61,145 vs 20-day low $61,145): Confirms support at the low.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.56): Lower volume compared to previous average, low confidence in bounce.
· Current phase diagnosis (Potential accumulation phase): RSI oversold exit and MACD improvement signals confirmed, consider buying if support holds.
